channel.title: The Catholic Review - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Catholic Review (catholicreview.org)

item.title: Security strains, political tensions cloud potential papal visit to Cameroon
item.description: Cameroon’s possible inclusion in the itinerary of Pope Leo XIV’s first African trip is drawing growing debate, as security concerns, political tensions and moral objections raise questions about whether the country is ready for a papal visit.

item.title: Sheen beatification is back on — and Engstrom family says it will be ‘a little piece of heaven’
item.description: James' heart started to beat just as the medical team at OSF Saint Francis Medical Center in Peoria decided they were out of options. The newborn's healing, which doctors could not explain, was attributed to the intercession of Archbishop Sheen. It became the miracle that cleared the way for his beatification.

item.title: ‘Mass for Solidarity’ celebrates bonds of faith between African and US Catholics
item.description: The Church in the United States and the Church in Africa "are two lungs of the same Body, breathing the same Spirit," a Nigerian bishop told Massgoers in Washington, emphasizing how the Church in both countries are united in Christ.

item.title: Thousands of Christians gather at Bangladesh’s famed shrine despite anxiety of election violence
item.description: Thousands of pilgrims have gathered at St. Anthony's shrine in Bangladesh's Archdiocese of Dhaka, despite anxiety and fears of violence, ahead of national elections in Muslim-majority Bangladesh, as they pray for peace in Bangladesh and the world.

item.title: Religious Liberty Commission tussles over antisemitism as lawsuit challenges its legality
item.description: The Religious Liberty Commission held its fifth hearing -- with some tense exchanges -- to examine a rise in antisemitism Feb. 9, the same day a lawsuit was filed challenging the committee's creation as unlawful.

item.title: Jimmy Lai’s daughter hopes for ‘political solution’ after devastating sentence
item.description: The daughter of imprisoned media entrepreneur and pro-democracy advocate Jimmy Lai said that while the 20-year sentence he was given was heartbreaking, her family, and especially her father, still trusts in "divine providence" for a solution.

item.title: Pope expected to visit Australia for 2028 International Eucharistic Congress, bishop says
item.description: Pope Leo XIV is expected to visit Australia in 2028 to preside over the International Eucharistic Congress, an auxiliary bishop of Sydney has announced.

item.title: Oblate Sister M. Felicia Avila, who ministered at St. Ambrose, dies at 89
item.description: A funeral Mass for Oblate Sister of Providence M. Felicia Avila will be offered at 11 a.m. Feb. 13 at the Oblate Sisters of Providence motherhouse chapel in Arbutus. Sister Felecia, whose more than 60 years of ministry included serving at St. Ambrose Parish in Park Heights, died Feb. 2. She was 89.

item.title: Vatican aid a sign of Pope Leo’s closeness to suffering Ukrainians, papal almoner says
item.description: As a relentless winter descends upon wartorn Ukraine with temperatures dropping to 5 degrees Fahrenheit, the Holy See has intensified its humanitarian response to the nation's energy and health crises.

item.title: Pope Leo XIV expected to visit Assisi during Year of St. Francis, archbishop says
item.description: The Italian hill town of Assisi is anticipating a visit from Pope Leo XIV during the special Jubilee Year of St. Francis as the city celebrates the 800th anniversary of the death of its most famous saint.
